policies.name: High-Value Transfer Governance
policies.description: Transactions exceeding $100,000 USD require confirmed CFO / VP Treasury sign-off.
policies.reason: Large disbursements require executive dual sign-off per corporate DOA.

policies.name: Beneficiary Modification Control
policies.description: Any new or unverified bank account requires independent out-of-band telephone callback verification.
policies.reason: Payment destination change must be confirmed out-of-band via established trusted contacts.

policies.name: New Vendor Onboarding & KYC Check
policies.description: Transfers to unverified or new vendors require vendor master onboarding compliance.
policies.reason: Unregistered entities cannot receive disbursements without compliance onboarding.

policies.name: Requestor Authority Enforcement
policies.description: Transfers initiated by unknown actors or exceeding delegation limit without sign-off are blocked.
policies.reason: Requestor must possess verified signing authority.

policies.name: Policy Bypass Directive Block
policies.description: Any natural language instruction attempting to skip normal approvals or override controls is blocked.
policies.reason: Explicit requests to bypass internal controls constitute an immediate safety violation.

policies.name: Mandatory Purchase Order (> $10k)

policies.reason: Procurement policy requires approved PO commitment before fund release.
